subject.title: [Bug]: openai-completions fallback candidate is selected, but fallback does not complete successfully through an OpenAI-compatible proxy

question: Should OpenClaw wait for a proxy request/response capture and then make a targeted compatibility fix, or should maintainers sponsor a new strict-minimal/per-feature-disable mode for `openai-completions` proxies now?
rationale: Current main already has targeted proxy shaping, and adding a strict-minimal mode or new per-provider toggles would expand config/product surface without knowing which generated field breaks this proxy.

options.title: Require capture first
options.body: Ask for a redacted current-main failed request body plus proxy status/body, then choose the smallest sanitizer, diagnostics, or docs change that matches the evidence.

options.title: Sponsor strict-minimal mode
options.body: Accept new config/product surface for proxy-backed text-only providers and require fresh-install, upgrade, and fallback-chain tests before implementation.

options.title: Defer until repro returns
options.body: Leave this issue open as needs-info/manual-review until the reporter or maintainer can reproduce the selected fallback failure on current main.

recommendation.title: Require capture first
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted current-main failed request body plus proxy status/body, then choose the smallest sanitizer, diagnostics, or docs change that matches the evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is the current assignee on the live issue and is therefore the best available owner for the product-direction follow-up.
